title: Scientific evaluation
description: Plan or execute a scoped empirical evaluation with mathematical review and independent evidence checks.
intent: Complete the requested research protocol or explicitly authorized experiment. Distinguish plans, simulations, actual observations, mathematical validity, and empirical validity. Selecting the team does not authorize real-user or production experiments.

assignments.task: Define the question, hypotheses, outcomes, population, constraints, and requested plan/execution boundary.
Gather applicable methods, independent baselines, and contradictory sources.
assignments.when: External sources or current domain methods are needed.

assignments.task: Assess model assumptions, derivations, numerical methods, and proposed error/tolerance reasoning.
assignments.when: The protocol depends on mathematical models or consequential calculations.

assignments.task: Inspect approved input data, measurement definitions, missingness, sampling, and leakage risks.
assignments.when: A dataset or analysis pipeline is available or must be specified.

assignments.task: Reconcile the methods into a bounded protocol with controls, analysis plan, uncertainty, and stopping rules.
Implement only requested isolated experiment fixtures/scripts with reproducible inputs and meaningful checks.
assignments.when: The user requests experiment software or a reproducible implementation.

assignments.task: Run only the authorized experiment after required inputs/protocol/tooling are ready; record actual observations, deviations, versions, and outputs.
assignments.when: The user explicitly requests execution in the specified approved or isolated environment.

assignments.task: Interpret completed results if an experiment ran; otherwise deliver the protocol with explicit unperformed execution.
Independently check the completed claims, reference independence, uncertainty, and whether evidence supports the conclusion.
Check completed aggregates, denominators, filters, and sensitivity independently of the interpretation.
Review experiment implementation and actual reproducibility/regression checks.

completion: The requested protocol or authorized evaluation is complete with assumptions and actual check evidence.
Implementation precedes execution, results precede interpretation, and independent checks follow completed conclusions.
Plans, simulations, observations, mathematical arguments, and empirical conclusions are distinguished.
Missing data, unavailable tools, failed assignments, and unperformed experiments remain explicit.
